$comment: Tool-level enforcement of CLAUDE.md rule 2c. Tracked on purpose, so the
protection travels with the repository and check_repo_clean.sh check 8 can
verify it is still here and still complete.
configs/agent_denylist.txt is the source of truth for WHICH paths. Every
entry there must appear below, and check 8 fails if one does not. Do not
add a path here without adding it there, or the two lists drift and the
one nobody reads is the one that was protecting something.
Read deny rules cover the file-reading tools. Bash routes around them
entirely - cat, head, ls, find, python3 -c - so scripts/agent_guard.sh runs
as a PreToolUse hook and blocks any command naming a denied path.
settings.local.json is NOT tracked and is itself denied: permission
allow-lists accrete literal command lines, and those have carried input
